answer: Plant honeypot answers. Each epoch the network slips 20 decoy submissions into the grading pool, each with a known flaw, such as claiming a lotus blooms on a dry stone terrace at dawn. Honest graders reject them. A puppet farm that approves everything to boost its own scores approves the decoys too. Approving even one decoy zeroes that account's vote weight for 10 epochs and forfeits its 20-token bond. A 1,000-puppet farm that grades blindly loses about 20,000 tokens per epoch, so each puppet must actually read and judge every answer, which costs as much as honest work.
